p01.title: Platform Overview
p01.subtitle: Cross-tenant platform health, capacity, resource usage and cost — aggregated metrics only.
p01.view_only_note: This console shows only platform metric/resource data; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, customer data) is not displayed.
p01.regions_caption: Cross-tenant health and concurrency by region

p02.title: Tenant Management & Provisioning
p02.subtitle: Tenant create/suspend/delete, plan assignment and lifecycle status — tenant registry/resource metadata only.
p02.manage_only_note: This screen is managed only by platform_owner (platform_sre/platform_billing have no access). Only tenant registry/resource metadata is shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, customer data) is not displayed.
p02.backend_authz_note: Provisioning actions are a visual gate only; create, suspend, delete and plan assignment have final authorization and state transition enforced in the backend.
p02.directory_caption: Tenant directory — plan, region, status and assigned resource (user count)
p02.provisioning_caption: Tenants in provisioning/deprovisioning and step progress

p03.title: Resource & Capacity Management
p03.subtitle: vCPU/memory/concurrency/CPS quotas, autoscale policy, scale-to-zero and noisy-neighbor protection — resource/capacity metadata only.
p03.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_owner and platform_sre (platform_billing has no access). Only resource/capacity metadata is shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, customer data) is not displayed.
p03.backend_authz_note: Quota and policy changes are a visual gate only; final authorization and enforcement happen in the backend Resource Manager Quota Service.
p03.noisy_neighbor_alert: {count} tenant(s) at high usage on shared isolation — noisy-neighbor risk monitored.
p03.no_noisy_neighbor: No tenants at high-usage risk on shared isolation.
p03.regions_caption: Concurrency/CPS capacity and worker utilization per region
p03.quotas_caption: Per-tenant resource quotas, isolation and scale-to-zero state

p04.title: Provider & Integration Health
p04.subtitle: STT/TTS/LLM/telephony adapter health, fallback/routing defaults and provider cost — provider/adapter metadata only.
p04.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_owner and platform_sre; platform_billing has view-only access. Only provider/adapter health and routing metadata is shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, customer data) is not displayed.
p04.backend_authz_note: Routing and fallback default changes are a visual gate only; final authorization and enforcement happen in the backend via the adapter SPI (provider:routing:manage).
p04.redundancy_alert: {count} categor(y/ies) do not meet the ≥2 operational provider rule — fallback resilience at risk (BRD §19).
p04.no_redundancy_risk: All categories are resilient with ≥2 operational providers (BRD §19).
p04.routing_caption: Per-category primary provider, fallback order and deterministic flow backup
p04.adapters_caption: Per-adapter category, role, health, circuit breaker, error rate and p95 latency
p04.cost_caption: Per-category provider cost (today / month-to-date) and unit cost

p05.title: Platform Billing & Rate-Card
p05.subtitle: Plan definitions, pricing (rate-card) and cross-tenant usage aggregation — billing and aggregated usage metadata only.
p05.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_billing; platform_owner has view-only access and platform_sre has no access. Only billing/plan/rate-card and aggregated usage are shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, end-customer data) is not displayed.
p05.backend_authz_note: Rate-card/plan editing and finance system export are a visual gate only; final authorization and enforcement happen in the backend (billing:rate_card:manage / billing:plan:manage / billing:export).
p05.over_budget_alert: {count} tenant(s) over budget — budget alarm triggered (FR-BIL-006).
p05.rate_card_caption: Per-category sell unit rate, underlying provider cost and margin (FR-BIL-002)
p05.plans_caption: Per-plan base charge, included minute quota, overage rate, budget alert threshold and assigned tenant count
p05.usage_caption: Per-tenant billed minutes, overage, budget usage and billing status (aggregated)
p05.usage_total: Total billed minutes: {minutes} · total overage: {overage} min

p06.title: Global Policy & Guardrails
p06.subtitle: Platform-wide security policies (Policy Engine guardrails), model allowlist and default compliance profiles — platform defaults inherited by all tenants.
p06.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_owner; platform_sre has view-only access and platform_billing has no access. Only platform-wide policy/guardrail/model-allowlist and default compliance-profile metadata are shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, end-customer data) is not displayed.
p06.backend_authz_note: Guardrail, model allowlist and compliance profile editing is a visual gate only; final authorization and enforcement happen in the backend (policy:guardrail:manage / policy:model_allowlist:manage / policy:compliance_profile:manage). Policy enforcement happens at runtime in the Policy Engine.
p06.no_policy_gap: All mandatory guardrails are enabled — no policy gap (FR-LLM-006/007/009, FR-REC-004).
p06.policy_gap_alert: {count} mandatory guardrail(s) disabled — security policy gap (FR-LLM-007/009).
p06.no_train_ok: All active models keep tenant data out of training (FR-LLM-012).
p06.no_train_alert: {count} active model(s) have no-train default off — tenant data may be used for training (FR-LLM-012).
p06.guardrails_caption: Policy Engine guardrails: category, enforcement action, status, mandatoriness and traceability (SAD §6.2/§9.3)
p06.models_caption: Model allowlist: category, tier, permission status, no-train default, version pinning and regional availability (FR-LLM-001/002/011/012)
p06.profiles_caption: Default compliance profiles: country, sector, data residency, retention, tenant approval and override policy (BRD §14.4)

p07.title: Platform Audit & Security
p07.subtitle: Platform-wide immutable (WORM) audit log, break-glass access sessions and security events — access/operation metadata only, not tenant business content.
p07.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_owner; platform_sre can only view, platform_billing has no access. Only platform-wide audit/access/security metadata is shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, end-customer data) is not displayed.
p07.backend_authz_note: Audit export and break-glass approval are visual gates only; final authority and enforcement happen in the backend (audit:export / breakglass:approve). Audit records are kept in immutable (WORM) storage and access is itself audited.
p07.worm_ok: All audit records anchored to immutable (WORM) storage — no integrity gap (FR-IAM-006).
p07.worm_alert: {count} audit records not WORM-anchored — tamper risk (FR-IAM-006).
p07.compliance_ok: All break-glass sessions compliant — maker-checker, time-box and notification rules satisfied (FR-IAM-009/010).
p07.compliance_alert: {count} break-glass sessions violate compliance rules — maker-checker / time-box / tenant approval / notification (FR-IAM-005/009/010).
p07.critical_alert: {count} critical security events open — immediate investigation required.
p07.audit_caption: Platform-wide audit log: time, actor role, action, category, target tenant, outcome and WORM integrity (FR-IAM-006, FR-REC-009)
p07.break_glass_caption: Break-glass access sessions: tier, status, tenant, reason code, request/approval (maker-checker), time-box, tenant approval and notification (FR-IAM-009/010)
p07.break_glass_note: Break-glass is emergency access only — justified, time-boxed (max 4 hours, no standing access) and audited; this screen is the compliance view of that flow — content access is not performed here.
p07.security_caption: Platform-wide security events: time, type, severity, status and traceability

p08.title: Release & Deployment Management
p08.subtitle: Platform component versioning, feature flags and gradual rollout (canary/staged rollout) — not tenant business content, only platform release/deployment metadata.
p08.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_owner; platform_sre can edit, platform_billing has no access. Only platform-wide release/deployment/feature-flag metadata is shown; tenant business content (call recordings, transcripts, end-customer data) is not displayed.
p08.backend_authz_note: Deployment, gradual rollout and rollback actions are visual gates only; final authority and enforcement happen in the backend (release:deploy / release:rollback / featureflag:manage). All deployment/rollback operations are audited (P-07).
p08.health_ok: All production and canary releases are healthy — no failing deployment.
p08.health_alert: {count} production/canary release(s) are failing — deployment health risk (FR-AGT-006).
p08.canary_ok: All canary releases are healthy — gradual rollout can be advanced safely.
p08.canary_alert: {count} canary release(s) could not be validated (degraded/failing) — review before advancing the gradual rollout (FR-AGT-005).
p08.deploy_alert: {count} deployment event(s) failed — a rollback may be required (FR-AGT-006).
p08.flags_ok: All feature flags are consistently configured — no strategy/percentage mismatch.
p08.flags_alert: {count} feature flag(s) misconfigured — percentage strategy but rollout percentage at an extreme (0/100).
p08.releases_caption: Platform releases: version, component, stage (draft/staging/canary/production), rollout percentage, health, region and creation (FR-AGT-005/006)
p08.flags_caption: Feature flags: key, status, rollout strategy, rollout percentage, enabled tenant count and update
p08.flags_note: Feature flags control gradual rollout (percentage / internal / full); only the enabled tenant COUNT is shown, not the tenant list/identity (golden rule, BRD §17.7).
p08.events_caption: Deployment events: time, type (promote/rollback/flag change/canary pause), actor role, target and outcome

p09.title: Alarm & Incident (SRE)
p09.subtitle: Platform alarms (critical alarm catalog) and incident (SRE) management — not tenant business content, only platform-wide alarm/incident metadata.
p09.manage_only_note: This screen is managed by platform_owner and platform_sre; platform_billing has no access. Only platform-wide alarm/incident metadata is shown; tenant business content (call recording, transcript, end-customer data) is not displayed. platform_sre cannot see business content (BRD §17.2).
p09.backend_authz_note: Alarm silencing, incident assignment/acknowledgement and resolution actions are visual gates only; final authority and enforcement happen in the backend (alert:manage / incident:manage / incident:acknowledge). All alarm/incident operations are audited (P-07).
p09.firing_ok: No firing alarms — platform health indicators are below thresholds.
p09.firing_alert: {count} alarms are firing — immediate operational risk; SRE intervention required (BRD §15).
p09.budget_ok: All alarms within detection budget (≤ {budget} s) — critical alarm ≤ 2 min target met (NFR 10.1).
p09.budget_alert: {count} alarms exceeded the {budget} s detection budget — critical alarm ≤ 2 min target breached (NFR 10.1 / SR-PERF-008).
p09.critical_alert: {count} critical (sev1/sev2) incidents are open — priority response required (NFR 10.6).
p09.escalation_alert: {count} incidents escalated — IR runbook escalation step in progress (NFR 10.6).
p09.alarms_caption: Platform alarms: rule name, severity, signal class, scope (component/region), state, detection latency and fired time (BRD §15 / SAD §17.2)
p09.alarms_note: Alarm scope is a vendor-neutral component/region; not a tenant identity/list (golden rule, BRD §17.7). Critical alarm detection latency must be ≤ {budget} s (NFR 10.1 / SR-PERF-008).
p09.incidents_caption: Incidents (SRE): label, severity (sev1/sev2/sev3), status, on-call role, linked alarm, scope and opened time (NFR 10.6 / SR-SEC-008)
p09.incidents_note: On-call assignment is a ROLE (not a person/PII); incident scope is a vendor-neutral component/region (golden rule, BRD §17.7).
p09.events_caption: Incident event stream: time, type (triggered/acknowledged/escalated/mitigated/resolved/note), actor role, target incident and requirement

t01.title: Tenant Dashboard
t01.subtitle: Tenant KPIs, usage, cost and assigned resource quota consumption — your own tenant's aggregated data only.
t01.scope_note: This dashboard shows only your own tenant's aggregated metric/usage/cost/quota data; raw call recordings/transcripts/customer data are not embedded (viewable with authorization in operations screens).
t01.usage_caption: Call and minute usage by channel
t01.quota_caption: Resource quota assigned by L0 and consumption
t01.budget_alert: Monthly budget exceeded ({pct} used) — review the billing screen.

t02.title: Organisation & Structure
t02.subtitle: Brand, department, country and project structures under the tenant — your own tenant's organisation only.
t02.scope_note: This screen shows and manages your own tenant's organisation structure only; raw call recordings/transcripts/customer data are not embedded here. The brands/departments defined here feed the scope filter of user role assignments.
t02.orphan_alert: {count} project(s) reference a non-existent organisation unit — review structure references.
t02.scope_hint: Brand and department units are used in the scope filter (department/brand/campaign) of role assignments.
t02.units_caption: Tenant organisation units (brand, department, country) and hierarchy
t02.projects_caption: Tenant projects and linked organisation units

t03.title: User & Role Management
t03.subtitle: Tenant-scoped RBAC, SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM settings — only your own tenant's users and roles.
t03.scope_note: This screen shows and manages only your own tenant's users, role assignments and SSO/SCIM settings; raw call recordings/transcripts/customer data and SSO/SCIM secrets are not embedded here. Roles are immutable bundles; flexibility comes solely from the assignment scope filter.
t03.mfa_alert: {count} active user(s) do not have multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled — review the security policy.
t03.invalid_alert: {count} user(s) are assigned to an undefined role — review role references.
t03.scope_hint: Role assignments can be narrowed to a department/brand/campaign scope; fully custom permission roles are in scope for Phase 3 (enterprise/dedicated).
t03.roles_hint: Roles are immutable permission bundles (FR-IAM-011); there is no custom permission builder in v1. The final authorization decision is made in the backend.
t03.federation_hint: The SSO certificate and SCIM token are neither stored nor shown on this screen; only the connection state is displayed. Secret values are held in the backend secret store.
t03.users_caption: Tenant management users, their roles, scope, source and status
t03.roles_caption: Tenant roles (immutable bundles) and assigned user count

t04.title: Phone Number & SIP/Trunk
t04.subtitle: Number pool, SIP trunk/BYOC connections and outbound Caller ID — only your own tenant's telephony inventory.
t04.scope_note: This screen shows and manages only your own tenant's phone numbers, SIP trunk/BYOC connections and outbound Caller ID settings; raw call recordings/transcripts/caller customer numbers and SIP trunk secrets (registration password/auth token) are not embedded here. Numbers are in E.164 format.
t04.invalid_trunk_alert: {count} number(s) are bound to an undefined SIP trunk — review trunk references.
t04.invalid_e164_alert: {count} number(s) do not match the E.164 format — fix the number format.
t04.capacity_alert: {count} trunk(s) exceeded 90% of channel capacity — review capacity planning.
t04.caller_alert: {count} default Caller ID(s) are unverified — verify before outbound presentation.
t04.trunks_caption: SIP trunk / BYOC connections, type, region, flow, channel capacity and state
t04.numbers_caption: Tenant phone numbers (E.164), direction, bound trunk, assignment and status
t04.caller_ids_caption: Outbound Caller IDs, verification status and default presentation
t04.trunks_hint: SIP trunk and BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) connections are provider-neutral (ADR-002); registration password/auth token is not stored or shown on this screen, it is kept in the backend secret store.
t04.numbers_hint: Numbers are in E.164 format (FR-TEL-004); active numbers not assigned to an agent or campaign are counted as idle in the pool. Number allocation and assignment are ultimately enforced in the backend.
t04.caller_ids_hint: The outbound Caller ID is the number presented on calls; only verified numbers should be used as the default presentation. This screen manages the tenant's OWN presentation numbers, NOT caller customer data.

kpi.pool_hint: Active numbers not assigned to an agent/campaign

t05.title: Integration, Tool & API Key/Webhook
t05.subtitle: CRM/ERP/ticketing connections, tool definitions, API keys and webhooks — only your own tenant's integration configuration.
t05.scope_note: This screen shows and manages only your own tenant's enterprise system integrations, tool definitions, API keys and webhook definitions; raw call recordings/transcripts/customer PII and secrets (API key secret, webhook signing secret, integration credential) are not embedded here. A secret is returned only once on creation; it is kept in the backend secret store.
t05.invalid_ref_alert: {count} tool(s) are bound to an undefined integration — review integration references.
t05.insecure_webhook_alert: {count} webhook(s) do not use HTTPS — unencrypted delivery is blocked, HTTPS is mandatory.
t05.write_confirm_alert: {count} write-access tool(s) do not require customer confirmation — add confirmation for critical actions (FR-TOOL-006/007).
t05.no_schema_alert: {count} tool(s) are defined without JSON schema validation — add input/output validation (FR-TOOL-002).
t05.failing_webhook_alert: {count} webhook(s) failed on last delivery — review endpoint health.
t05.integrations_caption: Enterprise system integrations, type, authentication method, region, last sync and state
t05.tools_caption: Tool definitions, protocol, access level, schema validation, confirmation requirement and bound integration
t05.api_keys_caption: API keys, scopes, last use and status
t05.webhooks_caption: Webhook endpoints, subscribed events, last delivery and status
t05.integrations_hint: Integrations are provider-neutral (ADR-002); credentials (OAuth client secret/bearer token/password) are not stored or shown on this screen, they are kept in the backend secret store. Authentication is shown by method name only.
t05.tools_hint: Tools support REST/SOAP/GraphQL/webhook protocols (FR-TOOL-001); write operations have a separate security level (FR-TOOL-005) and require customer confirmation before critical actions (FR-TOOL-006/007). Tool invocation authority is ultimately enforced per agent in the backend (FR-TOOL-004).
t05.api_keys_hint: The API key secret value is shown only once at creation; the server stores only a hash (API.md §7.2). This screen shows only name, scope and status metadata; the key value is not stored here. Key rotation and revocation are ultimately enforced in the backend.
t05.webhooks_hint: Webhook URLs must use HTTPS (API.md §10); the signature verification secret (signing_secret) is returned only once on creation and is not stored or shown here. Delivery is at-least-once; the consumer must be idempotent.

t06.title: Compliance & Retention
t06.subtitle: Consent, recording policy, data residency, retention, compliance profile and DNC registries — your own tenant's compliance configuration only.
t06.scope_note: This screen shows and manages only your own tenant's compliance and retention POLICY; raw call recordings/transcripts, individual consent/DNC records, customer PII and secrets (KMS keys, provider credentials) are not embedded here. Individual data and secrets live in L2/data-plane.
t06.counsel_note: These values are engineering defaults; they must be validated by the tenant's legal counsel before production (DPIA §12). Resolution is most-restrictive-wins; tenant overrides may only tighten (audited).
t06.loosen_alert: {count} tenant override loosen the profile — this violates most-restrictive-wins, is written to audit and rejected by the backend.
t06.disclosure_alert: {count} required disclosure(s) (AI/recording) not configured — complete the opening script (BRD §14.2).
t06.residency_alert: {count} data residency gap(s) — review region pinning/transfer mechanism (NFR 10.7).
t06.retention_alert: {count} retention period(s) invalid (≤0 days) — fix the retention configuration.
t06.recording_alert: {count} recording protection(s) missing — add PII redaction/card-OTP masking (FR-REC-004/005).
t06.outbound_alert: {count} outbound compliance gap(s) — define the consent registry/DNC source (FR-OUT-003/006).
t06.dpia_alert: DPIA status: {status} — high-risk processing cannot start before the onboarding gate is complete (DPIA §3).
t06.profile_caption: Resolved compliance profile: country profile, legal regime, sector overlays and lawful basis
t06.recording_caption: Recording policy: channel mode, consent model, PII redaction and card/OTP masking
t06.transparency_caption: Transparency and disclosure: AI disclosure, recording notice and no-impersonation
t06.residency_caption: Data residency: home region, in-region storage, provider region pinning and cross-border mechanism
t06.retention_caption: Retention periods (days): recording, transcript, audit and legal hold
t06.outbound_caption: Outbound compliance: consent model, consent registry, DNC sources, calling hours and Caller ID
t06.dsr_caption: Data subject rights (access/erasure/rectification/portability) and breach notification
t06.overrides_caption: Tenant overrides: parameter, profile baseline, override value and direction (tighten/loosen)
t06.profile_hint: Profile resolution is most-restrictive-wins (DPIA §6/§7); the country profile and sector overlay are combined. Values are subject to counsel validation.
t06.recording_hint: Recording policy is set per tenant/country/use-case (FR-REC-001) and can be fully disabled (FR-REC-002). PII redaction (FR-REC-004) and card/password/OTP removal (FR-REC-005) are applied before durable storage.
t06.transparency_hint: Per-call AI disclosure and recording notice may be required by profile (BRD §14.2); no-impersonation is always enforced (Policy Engine).
t06.residency_hint: Recordings/transcripts/prompts/KB/audit/backup are kept in the home region; provider region pinning is enforced via adapter region selection (NFR 10.7). Cross-border transfer requires an SCC/adequacy/explicit-consent mechanism (DPIA §D3).
t06.retention_hint: Retention is applied automatically (FR-REC-006); data is irreversibly deleted at the end of the period (FR-REC-010). Legal hold (FR-REC-007) overrides deletion while active. The audit log is WORM and cannot be shorter than the legal minimum.
t06.outbound_hint: Consent and suppression checks run before outbound (FR-OUT-003); 'do not call again' requests apply immediately (FR-OUT-006). In Turkey the İYS consent registry + ETK apply; permitted calling hours are enforced per country (FR-OUT-004). Individual consent/DNC records are not stored here; only source names are shown.
t06.dsr_hint: Data subject access and erasure requests are handled within SLA; erasure is bound to the retention/deletion engine (FR-REC-010). Breaches are reported to the authority within the deadline; data subjects are notified for high-risk cases.
t06.overrides_hint: Tenants may only TIGHTEN the profile (most-restrictive-wins; CLAUDE.md / DPIA §8); a loosening override is an audit violation and is rejected by the backend. This screen is a visual gate only; final authorization is in the backend (12.2.x) + RLS.

t07.title: Billing & Usage
t07.subtitle: Plan, usage, cost breakdown, quota/overage, budget alarm and invoice export — only your own tenant's billing view.
t07.scope_note: This screen shows only your own tenant's plan, aggregate usage and cost view; raw call recordings/transcripts, per-call CDR rows, customer PII and payment secrets (card, IBAN, finance system credentials) are not embedded here. Individual data and payment secrets live in the L2/data-plane and the finance/billing engine.
t07.illustrative_note: Price and cost values are illustrative; the binding rate-card is fed from the finance/billing engine (L0 P-05). Values are tenant-wide aggregate metrics only.
t07.over_budget_alert: Budget exceeded: period spend is at {ratio} of budget.
t07.usage_limit_alert: Usage limit exceeded: billed minutes passed the hard limit ({limit} min).
t07.reconcile_alert: Cost reconciliation gap: component total ({components}) does not match period spend ({spent}).
t07.export_failed_alert: Invoice export failed: the last export to the finance system errored.
t07.approaching_alert: Approaching budget: period spend is at {ratio} of budget.
t07.overage_blocked_alert: Quota exceeded ({minutes} min) but overage is disabled — extra calls may be capped.
t07.no_alarms_alert: A budget is set but no budget alarm is configured.
t07.export_unconfigured_alert: Invoice export not configured: the finance system target is undefined.
t07.export_caption: Invoice export status to the finance system
t07.plan_hint: Plan/rate-card changes are enforced in the backend (12.2.x); this layer only shows the resolved plan. Values are illustrative.
t07.usage_hint: Usage is metered by minute and second (FR-BIL-001); it is a tenant-wide aggregate only — not per-call CDR.
t07.cost_hint: Telecom, STT, TTS, LLM and platform costs are tracked separately (FR-BIL-002). The component total must reconcile with period spend.
t07.overage_hint: Quota overage and overage surcharge are supported (FR-BIL-004); when overage is disabled, exceeding the quota caps calls.
t07.budget_hint: Usage limit and budget alarm can be defined (FR-BIL-006); alarms fire when thresholds are crossed. The notification channel is shown by name only (not a secret).
t07.export_hint: Invoice data can be exported to the finance system (FR-BIL-007); the export target is shown by name only — API credentials are never placed in the panel.

t08.title: Audit Log
t08.subtitle: Your tenant's user and system change/access records — immutable (WORM) audit log, integrity chain and break-glass access.
t08.scope_note: This screen shows only your own tenant's audit records. Records are metadata only (actor, action, resource reference, time, integrity hash); raw call recordings/transcripts, customer PII and card/secret data are not embedded in the audit view. Platform (L0) appears only as break-glass access (FR-IAM-009).
t08.no_breakglass: No break-glass access in this window.
t08.no_entries: No audit records in this window.
t08.chain_broken_alert: Integrity warning: {count} break(s) detected in the hash chain (possible tampering — ADR-016).
t08.platform_no_bg_alert: Security warning: {count} platform (L0) access(es) recorded without a break-glass marker (FR-IAM-009 violation).
t08.worm_off_alert: Integrity warning: append-only/WORM enforcement is off — audit records must be immutable (FR-IAM-006).
t08.denied_alert: {count} denied (unauthorized) action record(s) present; security review recommended.
t08.retention_unset_alert: Audit retention period is not defined; review the compliance profile.
t08.seal_off_alert: Periodic external sealing is off; tamper-evidence is weakened (ADR-016 recommendation).
t08.integrity_hint: Records are kept WORM (append-only) and linked by a hash chain; periodic external sealing provides tamper-evidence (FR-IAM-006, ADR-016). Integrity hashes are a HEX prefix only — not a secret.
t08.breakglass_hint: Break-glass is the platform's (L0) explicit, time-boxed and audited access to tenant business content (FR-IAM-009). Every access is notified to the `security_compliance_officer` and `tenant_owner`.
t08.entries_hint: Records are immutable (WORM); there is no write/delete in the panel (FR-IAM-006). Export + advanced filtering are enforced in the backend (12.2.x). Resources are referenced only; raw content is not shown (BRD §17.7).

a02.subtitle: Real-time operations view of active calls
a02.scope_note: Only this tenant's own active calls are shown; data is real-time (≤60 s). Live listen and transcript are available in the call detail (A-12); final authorization is enforced in the backend.

a02.attention_caption: Calls with a critical flag, handoff request, or latency breach

a02.active_caption: All of the tenant's currently active calls
a02.active_hint: Party information is masked; raw transcript/recording is not embedded in this view (call detail A-12).

a03.title: Agent List
a03.subtitle: All agents and their states
a03.scope_note: Only your tenant's agent inventory is shown (tenant-scope). Create/edit/publish authority is enforced in the backend; this screen is a configuration view.
